remarks: Private, charming and beautifully appointed gem, just moments to downtown Westport is AVAILABLE 6/1/26 -10/31/26. This 1900s building was renovated and condominiumized in 1991 and updated 2021 with brand new kitchen and remodeled bath. Great Room with soaring ceiling, beams and bay window opens to the new kitchen. The second bedroom is currently being used as a den. A mattress can be provided. Spacious bluestone patio overlooks a lovely grassy meadow/open space. HOA requires minimum of 3 months rental term and the tenant to abide by condo bylaws. 1 parking place available. Easy ride to town, beaches, railroad, highways & all amenities. Owners prefer no pets.
